A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown how to construct a zeta function for a variety over a field of positive characteristic, and that it has the properties one would want of a zeta function, in particular that it interpolates the local factors.

the zeta function is a natural invariant of a variety over any field, not just a finite field.
